function.name: screen_capture
function.description: Capture the current desktop screen or a region. Returns the image file path, resolution dimensions, and optional base64 thumbnail.

include_base64.description: Include base64 JPEG data for immediate vision analysis

region.description: [x, y, width, height] bounding box or null for full screen

function.name: screen_ocr
function.description: Extract all visible text from the screen using OCR. Useful for finding text labels, reading error messages, and verifying UI state.

detailed.description: If true, returns word-level bounding boxes and confidence scores

function.name: screen_find
function.description: Locate text or a UI element label on the screen. Returns center (x, y) coordinates and bounding box.

target.description: Text or label to search for on screen

function.name: screen_describe
function.description: Get a semantic visual description of the screen or region using a vision model (Ollama LLaVA, GPT-4o, or Claude).

prompt.description: Specific question or guidance about what to inspect on screen

function.name: screen_click
function.description: Click at specific (x, y) pixel coordinates or find and click a text label on screen.

target.description: Text label to find and click if (x, y) not provided

function.name: screen_type
function.description: Type text into the currently active / focused window.

function.name: screen_press_key
function.description: Press a key or keyboard shortcut (e.g. 'enter', 'tab', 'ctrl+c', 'alt+tab').

function.name: screen_scroll
function.description: Scroll the mouse wheel. Negative values scroll down, positive values scroll up.

function.name: enhance_vision_prompt
function.description: Enhance any user prompt into a structured, vision-grounded prompt with explicit observation, grounding, and verification steps.
